description: This Java class defines a connection event producer for the Hono monitoring service, extending an abstract message sender class and utilizing a downstream sender factory to produce event senders based on the Hono Event API.

classes.name: HonoEventConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: A connection event producer using Hono's Event API, extending AbstractMessageSenderConnectionEventProducer.

methods.name: HonoEventConnectionEventProducer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection event producer with a downstream event sender created via the factory.
